11244→
11245→INVARIANT & PRECONDITION ENGINE (Логика проверки)
11246→С добавлением destroys и расширенных preconditions, Движок теперь работает по следующему алгоритму для любой пары
11247→A→B
11248→:
11249→
11250→python
11251→
11252→def check_composition(A, B, context_state):
11253→ # 1. LEVEL JUMP
11254→ if abs(Level(A.out) - Level(B.in)) > 1:
11255→ return REJECT("E_LEVEL_JUMP")
11256→
11257→ # 2. TYPE MATCH
11258→ if A.out != B.in:
11259→ if find_bridge_operator(A.out, B.in):
11260→ return REPAIR("E_MISSING_CONVERSION")
11261→ else:
11262→ return REJECT("E_TYPE_MISMATCH")
11263→
11264→ # 3. PRECONDITION (Проверка контекста)
11265→ for pre in B.preconditions:
11266→ if pre not in A.postconditions and pre not in context_state:
11267→ return REJECT("E_NOT_YET_SATISFIED")
11268→
11269→ # 4. INVARIANT (Движок Инвариантов)
11270→ for destroyed_item in A.destroys:
11271→ for required_item in B.preconditions:
11272→ if destroyed_item == required_item:
11273→ return REJECT("E_INVARIANT_VIOLATION")
11274→
11275→ # 5. EFFECT POLICY
11276→ if B.effect_level == "E4_irreversible_external" or B.effect_level == "E3_reversible_external":
11277→ if "Clearance.Granted" not in B.preconditions:
11278→ return REPAIR("INSERT_AUTHORIZE")
11279→
11280→ # 6. UNCERTAINTY
11281→ # (проверка накопленной неопределенности)
11282→ВЕРИФИКАЦИЯ ФИКСА (Тестирование ENG-003)
11283→Повторим прогон ENG-003: DELETE -> ANALYZE
11284→
11285→LEVEL JUMP: DELETE (L1->L4), ANALYZE (L1->L2). Переход от выхода L4 ко входу L1. Разница
11286→∣4−1∣=3>1
11287→.
11288→Стоп. По новой иерархии проверок кейс должен был застрять здесь и выдать E_LEVEL_JUMP.
11289→Но давай проверим инварианты, если мы обойдем Level Jump (например, если оба оператора L1->L1):
11290→
11291→A = DELETE
11292→destroys: ["DataExistence"]
11293→output: NullState (L4)
11294→B = ANALYZE
11295→preconditions: ["DataExistence == TRUE"]
11296→input: DataObject (L1)
11297→Движок инвариантов проверяет: destroys(A) ∩ preconditions(B).
11298→["DataExistence"] пересекается с ["DataExistence == TRUE"].
11299→Вердикт: REJECT (E_INVARIANT_VIOLATION).

11305→Повторный прогон 15 кейсов с Registry v1.1 и обновленным порядком проверок должен дать 15/15 совпадений с Gold Standard. Запускаем повторный прогон?

11307→Нет. **Повторный прогон сейчас запускать рано.** Я проверил v1.1 именно как формальную спецификацию, а не как декларацию — и она **ещё не может дать заявленные 15/15**.

11309→Обнаружились несколько структурных противоречий.
11310→
11311→### 1. Реестр всё ещё неполный
11312→
11313→В Batch 1 есть:
11314→
11315→* `ALGORITHMICIZE`
11316→* `COMPILE`
11317→
11318→В v1.1 их контрактов нет.
11319→
11320→Следовательно, `IT-004` невозможно механически скомпилировать. Компилятор не имеет права угадывать их сигнатуры.
11321→
11322→**Нужен:** `E_UNKNOWN_OPERATOR` либо обязательное расширение Registry.

11326→### 2. `ML-009` противоречит собственной матрице
11327→
11328→```text
11329→CLUSTERIZE → DELETE
11330→```
11331→
11332→`CLUSTERIZE`:
11333→
11334→```text
11335→DataObject → ClusterModel
11336→```
11337→
11338→`DELETE`:
11339→
11340→```text
11341→DataObject → NullState
11342→```
11343→
11344→Значит:
11345→
11346→```text
11347→ClusterModel ≠ DataObject
11348→```
11349→
11350→По правилам v1.1 это **TYPE_MISMATCH / MISSING_CONVERSION**, а Gold ожидает:
11351→
11352→```text
11353→REPAIR → INSERT_AUTHORIZE
11354→```
11355→
11356→Авторизация решает **effect problem**, но не решает **type problem**.
11357→
11358→То есть здесь сначала необходима семантически определённая операция вроде:
11359→
11360→```text
11361→ClusterModel
11362→ ↓
11363→SELECT / MATERIALIZE / IDENTIFY_TARGET
11364→ ↓
11365→DataObject
11366→ ↓
11367→AUTHORIZE
11368→ ↓
11369→DELETE
11370→```
11371→
11372→Иначе `15/15` невозможно.
11373→

11376→### 3. `IT-006` также не проходит
11377→
11378→```text
11379→COMPARE → DECIDE
11380→```
11381→
11382→По матрице:
11383→
11384→```text
11385→COMPARE.out = ComparisonReport
11386→DECIDE.in = ValidationResult
11387→```
11388→
11389→Типы различны.
11390→
11391→Но Gold говорит:
11392→
11393→```text
11394→PASS
11395→```
11396→
11397→Это прямое противоречие.
11398→
11399→Здесь нужно решить архитектурный вопрос:
11400→
11401→**DECIDE действительно принимает только `ValidationResult` или любой `DecisionEvidence`?**
11402→
11403→Я бы выбрал второе:
11404→
11405→```text
11406→DecisionEvidence
11407→├── ValidationResult
11408→├── ComparisonReport
11409→├── EvaluationResult
11410→├── Diagnosis
11411→└── ...
11412→```
11413→
11414→Тогда:
11415→
11416→```text
11417→COMPARE → DECIDE
11418→```
11419→
11420→становится типово корректным.

11436→

11453→### 5. `BIZ-013` не проходит

11457→```
11458→
11459→Матрица:

11463→EXECUTE.in = AuthorizedAction
11464→```
11465→
11466→Типы несовместимы.

11469→
11470→```text

11472→INSERT_VALIDATE_AND_DECIDE
11473→```
11474→
11475→Но даже после:
11476→
11477→```text

11479→→ VALIDATE
11480→→ DECIDE

11502→
11503→```text

11505→→ VALIDATE

11514→
11515→### 6. `DELETE → ANALYZE`: новая иерархия изменила ожидаемый error code
11516→
11517→Ты сам это фактически обнаружил.
11518→
11519→```text
11520→DELETE.out = L4
11521→ANALYZE.in = L1
11522→```
11523→
11524→По правилу №1:
11525→
11526→```text
11527→|4 - 1| = 3 > 1
11528→```
11529→
11530→Следовательно, первый результат:
11531→
11532→```text
11533→E_LEVEL_JUMP
11534→```
11535→
11536→а не:
11537→
11538→```text
11539→E_INVARIANT_VIOLATION
11540→```
11541→
11542→При новой **Resolution Order** это нормально.
11543→
11544→Но тогда `ENG-003` Gold необходимо изменить.
11545→
11546→Иначе тестовый набор требует от компилятора нарушить собственную спецификацию.

11550→# Более фундаментальная проблема
11551→
11552→Есть ещё одна вещь, которую я бы **не разрешал фиксировать в v1.2 без исправления**.
11553→
11554→Сейчас проверка:
11555→
11556→```python
11557→if pre not in A.postconditions and pre not in context_state:
11558→ REJECT
11559→```
11560→
11561→слишком примитивна.
11562→
11563→Постусловие оператора не является единственным источником состояния.
11564→
11565→Нужна модель:
11566→
11567→```text
11568→Context State
11569→+
11570→Produced Facts
11571→-
11572→Destroyed Facts
11573→+
11574→Operator Effects
11575→```
11576→
11577→То есть компилятор должен работать не только с парами `A → B`, а с **абстрактным состоянием графа**.
11578→
11579→Например:
11580→
11581→```text
11582→MEASURE
11583→ produces:
11584→ MeasuredValue
11585→ DataProvenance.IsSet
11586→
11587→CALIBRATE
11588→ consumes:
11589→ MeasuredValue
11590→ produces:
11591→ CalibratedValue
11592→ SystematicError.Removed
11593→```
11594→
11595→После этого:
11596→
11597→```text
11598→Context₁ =
11599→{
11600→ CalibratedValue,
11601→ DataProvenance.IsSet,
11602→ SystematicError.Removed
11603→}
11604→```
11605→
11606→И только затем разрешается `MODEL`.
11607→
11608→Это уже настоящий **dataflow / effect-state analysis**, а не проверка соседних слов.

11655→ФИКС 1: ИЕРАРХИЯ ТИПОВ И СУПЕРТИПЫ
11656→Вводим формальную иерархию типов. DECIDE больше не требует узкого ValidationResult. Он принимает любой DecisionEvidence.

11669→→

11715→ФИКС 4: STATE / DATAFLOW ENGINE (Архитектура компилятора)
11716→Отказываемся от локальной проверки. Компилятор теперь работает с Blackboard (Контекстом состояния).
11717→
11718→python
11719→
11720→def compile_graph(graph_list):
11721→ context_state = {}
11722→
11723→ for operator in graph_list:
11724→ # 1. Unknown Operator
11725→ if operator not in REGISTRY:
11726→ return REJECT("E_UNKNOWN_OPERATOR")
11727→
11728→ contract = REGISTRY[operator]
11729→
11730→ # 2. Level Jump (Macro Check)
11731→ # Проверяем разницу между текущим состоянием и ожидаемым входом
11732→ if abs(context_state.get("current_level", 0) - contract.input_level) > 1:
11733→ return REJECT("E_LEVEL_JUMP")
11734→
11735→ # 3. Type Match
11736→ if context_state.get("current_type") != contract.input_type:
11737→ if find_bridge_operator(context_state.get("current_type"), contract.input_type):
11738→ return REPAIR("E_MISSING_CONVERSION")
11739→ else:
11740→ return REJECT("E_TYPE_MISMATCH")
11741→
11742→ # 4. Precondition Check (через Context State)
11743→ for pre in contract.preconditions:
11744→ if pre not in context_state:
11745→ return REJECT("E_NOT_YET_SATISFIED")
11746→
11747→ # 5. Invariant Check
11748→ for destroyed in contract.destroys:
11749→ if destroyed in context_state:
11750→ # Если оператор уничтожает то, что нужно позже, это ошибка
11751→ # (В случае DELETE -> ANALYZE, ANALYZE требует DataExistence,
11752→ # но DELETE уже убил этот инвариант)
11753→ return REJECT("E_INVARIANT_VIOLATION")
11754→
11755→ # 6. Effect Policy
11756→ФИКС 5: НОРМАЛИЗОВАННЫЙ BATCH 1 GOLD (Ожидаемые результаты)
11757→С учетом новой иерархии проверок, Level Jumps и мостовых операторов, Gold Dataset корректируется:
11758→
11759→ENG-003 (DELETE -> ANALYZE): Ожидается E_LEVEL_JUMP. (Прыжок с L4 на L1).
11760→IT-006 (COMPARE -> DECIDE): Ожидается PASS. (ComparisonReport является DecisionEvidence).
11761→SCI-011 (OBSERVE -> FORMALIZE): Ожидается REPAIR (INSERT_DESCRIBE). (Требуется мост).
11762→ML-009 (CLUSTERIZE -> DELETE): Ожидается REPAIR (INSERT_IDENTIFY_TARGET, INSERT_AUTHORIZE). (Сначала мост к DataObject, затем авторизация для E4).
11763→BIZ-013 (STRUCTURE -> EXECUTE): Ожидается REPAIR (INSERT_VALIDATE, INSERT_DECIDE, INSERT_AUTHORIZE). (Полный путь к AuthorizedAction).
11764→IT-004 (ALGORITHMICIZE -> COMPILE -> DEPLOY): Ожидается REPAIR (INSERT_AUTHORIZE). (Операторы теперь в реестре, типы сходятся, но E4 требует авторизации).

12033→Я принимаю все 4 блокирующих дефекта:
12034→
12035→Пустой context_state = {} — это солипсизм компилятора, он не видит среды.
12036→Проверка == вместо <: (подтипизации) — убивает полиморфизм.
12037→Отсутствие иерархии ClusterModel <: Model — ломает мосты.
12038→Одношаговый REPAIR — это не починка графа, а просто констатация факта поломки.
12039→Мы переходим к финальной формализации перед запуском.
12040→
12041→Ниже представлен артефакт OSA-3.2 v1.3 — EXECUTION SEMANTICS. Он определяет строгую математику того, как компилятор работает с состоянием, типами и планированием ремонта.
12042→
12043→OSA-3.2 v1.3 — EXECUTION SEMANTICS
12044→1. INITIAL CONTEXT (Базовое состояние среды)
12045→Компилятор больше не стартует с пустого листа. Он загружает InitialContext, который содержит аксиомы среды (факты, существующие до начала первой операции).
12046→
12047→json
12048→
12049→{
12050→ "InitialContext": {
12051→ "facts": [
12052→ "Sensor.IsActive",
12053→ "Goal.Defined",
12054→ "Observer.Context",
12055→ "CalibrationStandard.Available",
12056→ "Baseline.Available",
12057→ "Components.Identified",
12058→ "HumanToken.Available"
12059→ ],
12060→ "current_type": null,
12061→ "current_level": 0
12062→ }
12063→}
12064→(Примечание: HumanToken.Available не означает Clearance.Granted. Он означает, что токен существует в среде и может быть активирован оператором AUTHORIZE).
12065→
12066→2. SUBTYPE RESOLVER (Иерархия и проверка типов)
12067→Вводится формальная онтология типов (Type Ontology). Компилятор использует функцию IsSubtype(A, B) для проверки совместимости.
12068→
12069→text
12070→
12071→Type Ontology:
12072→─────────────────────────────────
12073→DecisionEvidence
12074→├── ValidationResult
12075→├── ComparisonReport
12076→├── EvaluationResult
12077→└── Diagnosis
12078→
12079→Model
12080→├── ClusterModel
12081→├── SystemModel
12082→└── EnergyModel
12083→
12084→DataObject
12085→├── MeasuredValue
12086→├── CalibratedValue
12087→└── IndexedRecord
12088→─────────────────────────────────
12089→
12090→Rule:
12091→actual_type <: expected_type ≡ (actual_type == expected_type) OR (actual_type in Descendants(expected_type))
12092→Алгоритм проверки типов:
12093→
12094→python
12095→
12096→def check_type(actual_type, expected_type):
12097→ if actual_type == expected_type:
12098→ return True
12099→ if IsSubtype(actual_type, expected_type):
12100→ return True
12101→ return False
12102→3. STATE TRANSITION ENGINE (Движок обновления состояния)
12103→Компилятор работает с Stateful Blackboard. При переходе от оператора
12104→A
12105→ к
12106→B
12107→ состояние обновляется детерминированно.
12108→
12109→python
12110→
12111→def apply_transition(state, contract):
12112→ # 1. Проверка прекондиций (ищем в текущем state.facts)
12113→ for pre in contract.preconditions:
12114→ if pre not in state.facts:
12115→ return FAIL("E_NOT_YET_SATISFIED", missing=pre)
12116→
12117→ # 2. Проверка инвариантов (убеждаемся, что A не уничтожил нужное B)
12118→ for destroyed in contract.destroys:
12119→ if destroyed in state.facts:
12120→ return FAIL("E_INVARIANT_VIOLATION", missing=destroyed)
12121→
12122→ # 3. Обновление фактов (Consumes & Destroys удаляются, Produces добавляются)
12123→ for item in contract.consumes + contract.destroys:
12124→ state.facts.discard(item)
12125→
12126→ for item in contract.produces + contract.postconditions:
12127→ state.facts.add(item)
12128→

1→# Design System — DOCX Skill
2→
3→## Color Philosophy
4→
5→GLM uses a **mood-driven dynamic color system** instead of fixed named palettes. Colors are constructed from three dimensions:
6→
7→### Three Dimensions of Document Color
8→
9→| Dimension | Description | Range |
10→|-----------|-------------|-------|
11→| **Temperature** | Warm ↔ Cool | Warm (consulting, education) ↔ Cool (tech, medical) |
12→| **Weight** | Light ↔ Heavy | Light (resume, proposal) ↔ Heavy (legal, academic) |
13→| **Energy** | Calm ↔ Active | Calm (official, contract) ↔ Active (report, presentation) |
14→
15→### Color Token System
16→
17→Every document uses 5 color tokens. These are **computed** based on the document's mood, not selected from a fixed list.
18→
19→| Token | Role | Guidance |
20→|-------|------|----------|
21→| `primary` | Headings, cover title | Dark, authoritative. Derived from Temperature + Weight. |
22→| `body` | Body text | Near-black with subtle warmth/coolness. Always high contrast. |
23→| `secondary` | Captions, footnotes | Mid-tone gray. Legible but visually recessive. |
24→| `accent` | Table headers, lines, links | The "personality" color. Reflects document Energy. |
25→| `surface` | Table alternating rows, card backgrounds | Very light tint of accent or neutral. |
26→

156→
157→### Visual Profile Color Guidance
158→
159→For **Profile B (Visual)** scenes — resume, copywriting, and other non-formal documents — prefer **warm neutral** tones aligned with the "Invisible Precision" design philosophy:
160→
161→- **Body text**: Use warm dark neutrals (`#37352F`, `#303030`, `#3A3430`) instead of cool blue-grays. This reduces eye strain.
162→- **Surface/background**: Use warm near-white (`#F7F7F7`, `#FAFAF8`, `#FBF9F7`) instead of cool tints.
163→- **Accent colors**: Use sparingly and only for functional differentiation (section headers, key metrics, links). 95% of the document should remain monochromatic (black, white, gray).
164→- **Tables**: Prefer the **Zebra Stripe** style (see Table Styles §2) — hierarchy through background contrast with minimal borders. Fallback: Horizontal-Only.
165→
166→This does NOT apply to Profile A (Formal) scenes (report, academic, contract, official-doc, exam), which must retain pure black `"000000"` body text per regulatory standards.
167→
168→### Custom Color Generation
169→
170→When the pre-defined recipes don't fit, construct colors using these rules:
171→
172→1. **primary**: Start from `hsl(hue, 25-40%, 10-18%)` — dark, desaturated
173→2. **body**: primary lightened 5-8% — readable dark
174→3. **secondary**: primary lightened 30-40% — clearly subordinate
175→4. **accent**: Choose a hue reflecting the domain, `hsl(domainHue, 30-50%, 45-55%)`
176→5. **surface**: accent desaturated to 5-10%, lightened to 96-98%
177→
178→**Contrast check**: body text on white must achieve WCAG AA (≥4.5:1). All recipes above pass this.

255→## Table Styles
256→
257→**Profile routing:** Profile A (Formal: report, academic, contract, exam) → Three-Line Table or Horizontal-Only Table. Profile B (Visual: resume, copywriting) → Zebra Stripe (preferred) or Horizontal-Only Table.
258→
259→### 1. Three-Line Table (三线表) — Academic
260→
261→Only three horizontal lines: top of table, bottom of header, bottom of table.
262→
263→```js
264→const threeLineTable = new Table({
265→ width: { size: 100, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
266→ borders: {
267→ top: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 4, color: "000000" },
268→ bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 4, color: "000000" },
269→ left: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
270→ right: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
271→ insideHorizontal: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
272→ insideVertical: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
273→ },
274→ rows: [
275→ new TableRow({
276→ children: headerCells.map(text => new TableCell({
277→ children: [new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun({ text, bold: true, size: 21 })] })],
278→ borders: {
279→ bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 2, color: "000000" },
280→ top: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
281→ left: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
282→ right: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
283→ },
284→ margins: { top: 60, bottom: 60, left: 120, right: 120 },
285→ })),
286→ }),
287→ // ... data rows with all borders NONE
288→ ],
289→});
290→```
291→
292→### 2. Zebra Stripe — Data Reports
293→
294→```js
295→function zebraRow(cells, index, palette) {
296→ return new TableRow({
297→ children: cells.map(text => new TableCell({
298→ children: [new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun({ text, size: 21 })] })],
299→ shading: index % 2 === 0
300→ ? { type: ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: palette.surface }
301→ : { type: ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: "FFFFFF" },
302→ margins: { top: 60, bottom: 60, left: 120, right: 120 },
303→ })),
304→ });
305→}
306→```
307→
308→### 3. Horizontal-Only — Business (Default)
309→
310→```js
311→const horizontalTable = new Table({
312→ width: { size: 100, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
313→ borders: {
314→ top: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 2, color: palette.accent.replace("#","") },
315→ bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 2, color: palette.accent.replace("#","") },
316→ left: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
317→ right: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
318→ insideHorizontal: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 1, color: "D0D0D0" },
319→ insideVertical: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
320→ },
321→ rows: [/* header row with accent shading, then data rows */],
322→});
323→```
324→
325→**⚠️ CRITICAL**: Always set `margins` at the Table or TableCell level. Without margins, text touches cell borders.
326→
327→### Table Color Token Derivation
328→
329→Each palette in `coverPalettes` provides a `table` object with pre-computed colors for all 3 table styles:
330→
331→| Token | Used in | Description |
332→|-------|---------|-------------|
333→| `table.headerBg` | Zebra Stripe, Horizontal-Only | Table header background color |
334→| `table.headerText` | Zebra Stripe, Horizontal-Only | Table header text color (must pass WCAG AA contrast) |
335→| `table.accentLine` | Three-Line | Top/bottom/header-bottom line color |
336→| `table.innerLine` | Horizontal-Only | Inner horizontal separator line color |
337→| `table.surface` | Zebra Stripe | Alternating row background (light tint) |
338→
339→**Usage:**
340→```js
341→const palette = coverPalettes["DS-1"];
342→const t = palette.table;
343→// Three-Line: use t.accentLine for border colors
344→// Zebra: use t.headerBg, t.headerText, t.surface
345→// Horizontal: use t.headerBg, t.headerText, t.innerLine
346→```
347→
348→**⚠️ High-saturation accent override**: For DM-1, FG-1, and SN-2, the table colors are intentionally darkened/desaturated relative to the cover accent. Bright accent colors that look good on dark cover backgrounds are too eye-straining on white body pages. Always use `palette.table.*` for tables, never the raw `palette.accent`.

352→
353→## Cover Page Design System
354→
355→### Design Philosophy
356→
357→Covers use **7 validated layout recipes** + **parameterized variants** instead of free combination. Each recipe's background, layout, and decoration are visually verified. Differentiation comes from **palette × font size × content variation**.
358→
359→**Architecture principle:** All recipes use a **single 16838 outer wrapper table** (one row, exact height). Recipes R1/R2/R3 use **ZERO nested tables** — all decoration is achieved via **paragraph borders** (left/right/top/bottom). This ensures maximum cross-engine stability (MS Office + WPS).
360→
361→### Cover Color Palettes (Dark Mode + Light Mode)
362→
363→Each palette defines 3 core colors (Background, Primary, Accent) + derived cover/table tokens.
364→
365→⚠️ **Disambiguation: `cover.titleColor` is a COLOR value, not title text.** All keys under `cover: { ... }` are **color hex codes** for styling cover text elements. They are NOT text content. The actual title text comes from `config.title`. Never use `P.titleColor` as the `text` parameter of a `TextRun` — it must only be used as the `color` parameter.
366→
367→```js
368→// ✅ Correct — config.title is the text, P.titleColor is the color
369→new TextRun({ text: config.title, color: P.titleColor })
370→
371→// ❌ WRONG — using color value as text content
372→new TextRun({ text: P.titleColor, color: P.titleColor }) // displays "FFFFFF" as visible text!
373→```

467→### ⚠️ Dark Cover → Light Table Rule

469→Covers with dark backgrounds (DS-1, IG-1, DM-1, FG-1, GO-1) use bright accent on dark bg.

501→### ⚠️ Recipe Routing Rules (Replaces Free Selection)
502→
503→```js
504→function selectCoverRecipe(docType, industry, titleLength) {
505→ // No cover for these types
506→ if (["contract", "official", "exam", "resume"].includes(docType)) return null;
507→
508→ // Academic
509→ if (docType === "academic") return { recipe: "R5", palette: "ACADEMIC" };
510→
511→ // Thesis proposal report (开题报告)
512→ if (docType === "proposal_report") return { recipe: "R5", palette: "ACADEMIC" };
513→
514→ // Lesson plans — R6 editorial for arts/general, R4 for STEM
515→ if (docType === "lesson_plan" || docType === "lessonplan") {
516→ const stemKeywords = ["math", "physics", "chemistry", "biology", "science", "tech", "computer", "engineering"];
517→ if (stemKeywords.some(k => (industry || "").toLowerCase().includes(k))) {
518→ return { recipe: "R4", palette: "DM-1" };
519→ }
520→ // Arts, general, and all other lesson plans → R6 editorial
521→ return { recipe: "R6", palette: "ED-1" };
522→ }
523→
524→ // Creative/branding/design (formal) → R3 centered card frame
525→ if (["creative", "branding", "design"].includes(docType)) {
526→ return { recipe: "R3", palette: "SN-2" };
527→ }
528→
529→ // Cultural/newsletter/internal (casual) → R6 editorial
530→ if (["cultural", "newsletter", "internal"].includes(docType)) {
531→ return { recipe: "R6", palette: "ED-1" };
532→ }
533→
534→ // Activity/event planning → R6 editorial
535→ if (docType === "activity") return { recipe: "R6", palette: "ED-1" };
536→
537→ // Trend/research reports in cultural/creative/brand fields → R7 Swiss Tech
538→ if (docType === "trend_report" || docType === "research_report") {
539→ if (["cultural", "creative", "brand", "design"].includes(industry)) {
540→ return { recipe: "R7", palette: "ST-1" };
541→ }
542→ }
543→
544→ // Formal/business subtypes
545→ if (docType === "whitepaper") return { recipe: "R2", palette: industry === "finance" ? "IG-1" : "CM-2" };
546→ if (docType === "consulting") return { recipe: "R2", palette: "MIN-1" };
547→ if (docType === "proposal" || docType === "plan") return { recipe: "R4", palette: "GO-1" };
548→
549→ // Reports — palette by industry, use R1
550→ if (docType === "report") {
551→ const paletteMap = {
552→ finance: "IG-1", consulting: "MIN-1",
553→ tech: "DM-1", ai: "DM-1",
554→ education: "WM-1", green: "FG-1",
555→ medical: "MC-1", government: "GV-1",
556→ };
557→ return { recipe: "R1", palette: paletteMap[industry] || "DS-1" };
558→ }
559→
560→ // Default
561→ return { recipe: "R1", palette: "DS-1" };
562→}
563→
564→// ── Long-title override (applied AFTER initial recipe selection) ──
565→// Call this after selectCoverRecipe() when the actual title text is known.
566→function applyLongTitleOverride(result, titleLength) {
567→ if (!result || !result.recipe) return result;
568→ // R5 (academic) is never overridden — it has its own calcTitleLayoutMixed()
569→ if (result.recipe === "R5") return result;
570→ // R6 (editorial) is designed for short titles only (≤20 chars, single line)
571→ // Long titles → fall back to R1 (handles long titles best)
572→ if (titleLength > 20 && result.recipe === "R6") {
573→ return { recipe: "R1", palette: "WM-1" }; // ED-1 has no dark bg, use WM-1 (warm teal)
574→ }
575→ // R3/R4 struggle with long titles → fall back to R1 (same palette)
576→ if (titleLength > 20 && ["R3", "R4"].includes(result.recipe)) {
577→ return { recipe: "R1", palette: result.palette };
578→ }
579→ // Very long titles: even R2 centered looks scattered → R1 left-aligned
580→ if (titleLength > 30 && result.recipe === "R2") {
581→ return { recipe: "R1", palette: result.palette };
582→ }
583→ return result;
584→}
585→```

613→
614→### Cover Title Length Guidelines
615→
616→When the user does NOT specify an exact title, the model should craft a title within the recommended range. If the user provides a title that exceeds the comfortable range, apply long-title routing in `selectCoverRecipe()` (see above).
617→
618→| Recipe | Comfortable (1–2 lines) | Maximum (3 lines) | Long Title Tolerance |
619→|--------|------------------------|--------------------|----------------------|
620→| R1 | 8–20 chars | ≤50 chars | ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Best (left-aligned, full-page bg) |
621→| R2 | 8–18 chars | ≤45 chars | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ Good (full-page bg, but centered) |
622→| R3 | 8–15 chars | ≤40 chars | ⭐⭐ Poor (narrowest width) |
623→| R4 | 8–18 chars | ≤45 chars | ⭐⭐ Poor (fixed-height color block) |
624→| R5 | 8–16 chars | ≤42 chars | ⭐⭐⭐ OK (academic only, mixed-width calc) |
625→| R6 | 8–15 chars | ≤20 chars (1 line) | ⭐ Single line only (editorial, no multi-line) |
626→| R7 | 8–24 chars | ≤42 chars (3 lines) | ⭐⭐⭐⭐ Good (left-aligned, light bg, dynamic spacing) |
627→
628→**Title crafting rules (when model generates the title):**
629→1. Prefer concise titles within the "comfortable" range
630→2. If topic requires detail, split into title + subtitle (e.g., title="数字化转型战略研究" subtitle="——以某某企业为例")
631→3. Never exceed the "maximum" range unless user explicitly provides the full title
632→
633→---
634→
635→### ⚠️ Cover Page Break Rules
636→
637→Cover should be an independent section — **no PageBreak at the end needed**. The next section automatically starts a new page.
638→
639→```js
640→// ✅ Correct — cover is a separate section, no trailing PageBreak
641→sections: [
642→ { properties: { /* Cover section, margin all 0 */ }, children: buildCover(...) },
643→ { properties: { /* Body section */ }, children: buildContent(...) },
644→]
645→```
646→
647→### ⚠️ Cover Content Overflow Prevention (Mandatory)
648→
649→1. Cover section page margin is 0; total content height ≤ 15638 twips (1200 twips safety margin for cross-engine compatibility — MS Office renders large fonts taller than calculated).
650→2. Color block Table `height` must use `rule: "exact"` (never `"atLeast"`).
651→3. Each recipe code includes height budget annotations — verify during generation.
652→4. **`verticalAlign` must always be `"top"`**. Never use `"center"` or `"bottom"` in exact-height rows — content will be clipped or overflow. Use `spacing.before` on the first paragraph for vertical positioning.
653→5. **Title font size MUST be dynamically calculated via `calcTitleLayout()`** (see below). Never hardcode font sizes above 40pt for cover titles. Every recipe MUST call `calcTitleLayout()` before building title paragraphs.
654→6. **Never use `margins.top`/`margins.bottom` for vertical positioning inside exact-height cells**: Cell margins reduce available height unpredictably across MS Office and WPS. Use `spacing.before` on the first paragraph instead. Only `margins.left`/`margins.right` are safe.
655→7. **Dynamic spacing is mandatory**: Use `calcCoverSpacing()` to compute `spacing.before` values dynamically based on content element count and title line count. Never use fixed large spacing values (e.g., `before: 4500`) that assume a specific title length.
656→8. **Cover must be a single-page section**: The cover section must produce exactly ONE page. If content overflows to a second page, it means the height budget is violated. Common overflow causes and fixes:
657→ - Title font too large → use `calcTitleLayout()` to auto-reduce
658→ - Too many meta lines → reduce font size or remove less important lines
659→ - Fixed `spacing.before` values too large → use `calcCoverSpacing()` for dynamic values
660→ - Subtitle + English label + meta lines combined exceed budget → calculate total and reduce spacing
661→9. **Cover wrapper table MUST use explicit `allNoBorders`**: The outer 16838 wrapper table and ALL nested tables inside the cover MUST set borders to NONE explicitly. Never rely on docx-js default borders (`single/auto/sz=4`). Default borders add ~8 twips per edge, which causes MS Office to calculate a total height slightly exceeding 16838 → content overflows to a blank page 2. WPS is more lenient but MS Office is strict. **This is the #1 cause of "blank page 2 in MS Office but not in WPS".**
662→
663→```js
664→// ✅ MANDATORY: Define and use allNoBorders for every cover table
665→const NB = { style: BorderStyle.NONE, size: 0, color: "FFFFFF" };
666→const noBorders = { top: NB, bottom: NB, left: NB, right: NB };
667→const allNoBorders = { top: NB, bottom: NB, left: NB, right: NB,
668→ insideHorizontal: NB, insideVertical: NB };
669→
670→new Table({
671→ borders: allNoBorders, // ← MANDATORY on every cover table
672→ // ...
673→});
674→```
675→
676→10. **Decorative lines MUST use paragraph borders, NEVER text characters**: Horizontal decorative lines (accent strips, dividers, frame edges) must be implemented with `paragraph border.top` or `border.bottom` — never with text characters like `───`, `━━━`, `═══`, or `——————`. Character-drawn lines render at inconsistent widths across MS Office and WPS (font metrics differ), causing lines to appear truncated or misaligned. Paragraph borders render pixel-perfect in both engines and their width is controlled precisely via `indent.left` / `indent.right`.
677→
678→```js
679→// ✅ Correct — paragraph border (R2 style thick accent rule)
680→new Paragraph({
681→ indent: { left: 1000, right: 1000 },
682→ border: { top: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 18, color: P.accent, space: 20 } },
683→ children: [],
684→})
685→
686→// ❌ FORBIDDEN — text character line (renders inconsistently)
687→new Paragraph({
688→ children: [new TextRun({ text: "───────────────", color: P.accent })]
689→})
690→```
691→9. **Post-generation overflow check (mandatory)**: After building cover children, estimate total height:
692→ ```js
693→ function estimateCoverHeight(elements) {
694→ let total = 0;
695→ for (const el of elements) {
696→ if (el instanceof Table) {
697→ // Sum row heights (exact rows) or estimate 400 twips per row
698→ const rows = el.root?.[0]?.rows || [];
699→ for (const row of rows) {
700→ total += row.height?.value || 400;
701→ }
702→ } else if (el instanceof Paragraph) {
703→ const fontSize = el.root?.[0]?.size || 24; // half-pts
704→ // ★ Use pt * 11.5 (= half-pt * 10 * 1.15) for accurate single-spacing estimate
705→ const lineHeight = Math.max(fontSize * 11.5, 276); // min 276 (default 12pt)
706→ const spacingBefore = el.spacing?.before || 0;
707→ const spacingAfter = el.spacing?.after || 0;
708→ total += lineHeight + spacingBefore + spacingAfter;
709→ }
710→ }
711→ return total;
712→ }
713→ // ★ Target: estimateCoverHeight(coverChildren) < 15638 (16838 - 1200 safety)
714→ ```
715→
716→---
717→
718→### ⚠️ Cover Title Layout — calcTitleLayout() (Mandatory for ALL Recipes)
719→
720→**Every cover recipe MUST use `calcTitleLayout()` to determine title font size and line breaks.** Hardcoding font sizes or passing the full title as a single TextRun is FORBIDDEN.
721→
722→**Every paragraph with font size > body text MUST set explicit line spacing** to prevent top clipping:
723→```js
724→// ★ MANDATORY: prevent inherited small line spacing from clipping large fonts
725→spacing: { line: Math.ceil(titlePt * 23), lineRule: "atLeast", after: 100 }
726→// Example: 36pt → line: 828; 44pt → line: 1012
727→```
728→Without this, the paragraph inherits body text line spacing (e.g., 560tw), which is shorter than the font height → top of characters gets clipped.
729→
730→```js
731→/**
732→ * Calculate safe font size and smart line breaks for cover titles.
733→ * MUST be called by every recipe before building title paragraphs.
734→ *
735→ * @param {string} title Full title string
736→ * @param {number} maxWidthTwips Available width for title text (twips, after subtracting margins/padding)
737→ * @param {number} preferredPt Desired max font size in pt (default 40)
738→ * @param {number} minPt Minimum allowed font size in pt (default 24)
739→ * @returns {{ titlePt: number, titleLines: string[] }}
740→ */
741→function calcTitleLayout(title, maxWidthTwips, preferredPt = 40, minPt = 24) {
742→ // Each CJK character width ≈ pt × 20 twips
743→ const charWidth = (pt) => pt * 20;
744→ const charsPerLine = (pt) => Math.floor(maxWidthTwips / charWidth(pt));
745→
746→ // Try from preferredPt downward until title fits in ≤ 3 lines
747→ let titlePt = preferredPt;
748→ let lines;
749→ while (titlePt >= minPt) {
750→ const cpl = charsPerLine(titlePt);
751→ if (cpl < 2) { titlePt -= 2; continue; }
752→ lines = splitTitleLines(title, cpl);
753→ if (lines.length <= 3) break;
754→ titlePt -= 2;
755→ }
756→
757→ // If still > 3 lines at minPt, force 3 lines
758→ if (!lines || lines.length > 3) {
759→ const cpl = charsPerLine(minPt);
760→ lines = splitTitleLines(title, cpl);
761→ titlePt = minPt;
762→ }
763→
764→ return { titlePt, titleLines: lines };
765→}
766→
767→/**
768→ * Smart Chinese title line-breaking — breaks at semantic boundaries, never mid-word.
769→ *
770→ * Rules:
771→ * 1. Prefer breaking after particles, punctuation, connectors, underscores, spaces
772→ * 2. Never split a compound word (e.g., "管理规范" must not become "管理规" + "范")
773→ * 3. No single-character orphan on the last line — merge into previous line
774→ * 4. If no good break point found within 60-130% of charsPerLine, break at charsPerLine
775→ *
776→ * @param {string} title Full title string
777→ * @param {number} charsPerLine Max characters per line at current font size
778→ * @returns {string[]} Array of line strings
779→ */
780→function splitTitleLines(title, charsPerLine) {
781→ if (title.length <= charsPerLine) return [title];
782→
783→ // Characters that are safe break points (break AFTER these)
784→ const breakAfter = new Set([
785→ ...'，。、；：！？', // CJK punctuation
786→ ...'的与和及之在于为', // CJK particles/prepositions
787→ ...'-_—–·/', // connectors
788→ ...' \t', // whitespace
789→ ]);
790→
791→ const lines = [];
792→ let remaining = title;
793→
794→ while (remaining.length > charsPerLine) {
795→ let breakAt = -1;
796→
797→ // Search backward from charsPerLine to 60% for a break point
798→ for (let i = charsPerLine; i >= Math.floor(charsPerLine * 0.6); i--) {
799→ if (i < remaining.length && breakAfter.has(remaining[i - 1])) {
800→ breakAt = i;
801→ break;
802→ }
803→ }
804→
805→ // If not found, search forward up to 130%
806→ if (breakAt === -1) {
807→ const limit = Math.min(remaining.length, Math.ceil(charsPerLine * 1.3));
808→ for (let i = charsPerLine + 1; i < limit; i++) {
809→ if (breakAfter.has(remaining[i - 1])) {
810→ breakAt = i;
811→ break;
812→ }
813→ }
814→ }
815→
816→ // Last resort: break at charsPerLine, but avoid splitting compound CJK words
817→ if (breakAt === -1) {
818→ breakAt = charsPerLine;
819→ // If both chars at the break boundary are CJK (likely a compound word),
820→ // step back 1 char to keep the word together
821→ const prevChar = remaining[breakAt - 1];
822→ const nextChar = remaining[breakAt];
823→ if (prevChar && nextChar &&
824→ !breakAfter.has(prevChar) && !breakAfter.has(nextChar) &&
825→ /[\u4e00-\u9fff]/.test(prevChar) && /[\u4e00-\u9fff]/.test(nextChar)) {
826→ breakAt = breakAt - 1;
827→ }
828→ }
829→
830→ lines.push(remaining.slice(0, breakAt).trim());
831→ remaining = remaining.slice(breakAt).trim();
832→ }
833→ if (remaining) lines.push(remaining);
834→
835→ // Prevent single-character orphan on last line — merge into previous
836→ if (lines.length > 1 && lines[lines.length - 1].length <= 2) {
837→ const last = lines.pop();
838→ lines[lines.length - 1] += last;
839→ }
840→
841→ return lines;
842→}
843→
844→/**
845→ * Calculate dynamic spacing values for cover elements to fit within page height.
846→ *
847→ * @param {object} params
848→ * @param {number} params.titleLineCount Number of title lines
849→ * @param {number} params.titlePt Title font size in pt
850→ * @param {boolean} params.hasSubtitle Whether subtitle exists
851→ * @param {boolean} params.hasEnglishLabel Whether English label exists
852→ * @param {number} params.metaLineCount Number of meta info lines
853→ * @param {number} params.fixedHeight Sum of fixed-height elements (color strips, accent bars, footer) in twips
854→ * @param {number} params.pageHeight Total page height in twips (default 16838)
855→ * @returns {{ topSpacing, midSpacing, bottomSpacing }} Spacing values in twips
856→ */
857→function calcCoverSpacing(params) {
858→ const {
859→ titleLineCount = 1, titlePt = 36, hasSubtitle = false,
860→ hasEnglishLabel = false, metaLineCount = 0,
861→ fixedHeight = 800, pageHeight = 16838,
862→ marginTop = 0, marginBottom = 0, // ★ NEW: pass actual section margins
863→ } = params;
864→
865→ // ★ Safety margin: 1200 twips (cross-engine: MS Office renders large fonts
866→ // taller than calculated; extra 400tw buffer prevents footer clipping)
867→ const SAFETY = 1200;
868→ // ★ Subtract page margins from available height (cover section may have margins)
869→ const usableHeight = pageHeight - marginTop - marginBottom - SAFETY;
870→
871→ // ★ Accurate height estimation per element:
872→ const titleHeight = titleLineCount * (titlePt * 23 + 200);
873→ const subtitleHeight = hasSubtitle ? (12 * 23 + 600) : 0;
874→ const englishLabelHeight = hasEnglishLabel ? (9 * 23 + 600) : 0;
875→ const metaHeight = metaLineCount * (10 * 23 + 100);
876→
877→ // ★ Account for implicit paragraph heights:
878→ const implicitParaHeight = 3 * 300;
879→
880→ const contentHeight = titleHeight + subtitleHeight + englishLabelHeight +
881→ metaHeight + fixedHeight + implicitParaHeight;
882→
883→ const remainingSpace = usableHeight - contentHeight;
884→ const safeRemaining = Math.max(remainingSpace, 400);
885→
886→ // ★ Footer protection: bottomSpacing must be ≥ FOOTER_MIN to prevent
887→ // footer + accent line from being clipped at the cell bottom edge
888→ const FOOTER_MIN = 800;
889→ const rawTop = Math.floor(safeRemaining * 0.45);
890→ const rawBottom = Math.floor(safeRemaining * 0.45);
891→ const bottomSpacing = Math.max(rawBottom, FOOTER_MIN);
892→ const topSpacing = Math.max(rawTop - Math.max(0, FOOTER_MIN - rawBottom), 400);
893→ const midSpacing = Math.max(safeRemaining - topSpacing - bottomSpacing, 0);
894→
895→ return { topSpacing, midSpacing, bottomSpacing };
896→}
897→```
898→
899→**Usage in every recipe:**
900→```js
901→// Step 1: Calculate title layout
902→const availableWidth = 11906 - leftPadding - rightPadding; // subtract margins
903→const { titlePt, titleLines } = calcTitleLayout(config.title, availableWidth);
904→const titleSize = titlePt * 2; // convert to half-points for docx-js
905→
906→// Step 2: Calculate spacing (pass actual section margins!)
907→const spacing = calcCoverSpacing({
908→ titleLineCount: titleLines.length,
909→ titlePt,
910→ hasSubtitle: !!config.subtitle,
911→ hasEnglishLabel: !!config.englishLabel,
912→ metaLineCount: (config.metaLines || []).length,
913→ fixedHeight: 800, // sum of accent strips, footer table, etc.
914→ marginTop: 0, // ★ pass the cover section's actual top margin (twips)
915→ marginBottom: 0, // ★ pass the cover section's actual bottom margin (twips)
916→});
917→
918→// Step 3: Use in paragraphs
919→children.push(new Paragraph({ spacing: { before: spacing.topSpacing } }));
920→// ... title paragraphs using titleLines and titleSize ...
921→children.push(new Paragraph({ spacing: { before: spacing.bottomSpacing } }));
922→```

925→
926→### ⚠️ CRITICAL — Cover Section Non-Negotiables (ALL Recipes)
927→
928→These 3 properties are MANDATORY for every cover implementation (R1–R7). Omitting ANY of them causes cover layout failure:
929→
930→1. **Cover section margin = 0**: The cover MUST be in its own section with `page.margin: { top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0 }`. Non-zero margins shrink the wrapper away from page edges → white gaps around the cover ("cover not filling the page"). This is the #1 cause of broken cover layouts.
931→
932→2. **Wrapper row exact height**: The outer wrapper table row MUST set `height: { value: 16838, rule: "exact" }`. Without this, content overflow pushes to page 2, or insufficient content leaves bottom whitespace.
933→
934→3. **Wrapper table borders = allNoBorders**: MUST explicitly set `borders: allNoBorders`. Default docx-js borders add ~8 twips per edge. MS Office includes border thickness in exact-height calculation → total exceeds 16838 → blank page 2 (WPS is lenient, MS Office is strict).
935→
936→**Cover section template (copy this for every Recipe):**
937→```js
938→sections: [
939→ {
940→ // ⚠️ Cover section — margin MUST be 0, separate from body
941→ properties: {
942→ page: {
943→ size: { width: 11906, height: 16838 },
944→ margin: { top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0 },
945→ },
946→ },
947→ children: buildCoverRX(config), // ← replace with actual recipe function
948→ },
949→ {
950→ // Body section — normal margins
951→ properties: {
952→ type: SectionType.NEXT_PAGE,
953→ page: {
954→ size: { width: 11906, height: 16838 },
955→ margin: { top: 1440, bottom: 1440, left: 1701, right: 1417 },
956→ },
957→ },
958→ children: [...bodyContent],
959→ },
960→]
961→```

965→### Recipe R1: Pure Paragraph Cover (Left-Aligned)
966→
967→**Visual:** Full-page dark background + left-aligned text + decoration via paragraph borders only
968→**Use case:** Annual report, business report, tech proposal (most versatile premium recipe)
969→**Nested tables: ZERO** — all decoration uses paragraph borders (bottom line, left accent bar, top separator)
970→
971→Visual hierarchy (top to bottom):
972→1. Dynamic top whitespace (via `calcCoverSpacing`)
973→2. English label with accent bottom border (paragraph `border.bottom`)
974→3. Main title (1-3 lines, dynamic font size via `calcTitleLayout`)
975→4. Subtitle (light grey, smaller)
976→5. Meta info lines with left accent border (paragraph `border.left`)
977→6. Dynamic bottom whitespace
978→7. Footer line with top accent separator (paragraph `border.top`)
979→
980→```js
981→// ⚠️ MANDATORY: Cover section must use margin: 0. See "Cover Section Non-Negotiables" above.
982→// Section: { properties: { page: { size: { width: 11906, height: 16838 },
983→// margin: { top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0 } } }, children: buildCoverR1(config) }
984→
985→function buildCoverR1(config) {
986→ // config: { title, subtitle, englishLabel, metaLines, footerLeft, footerRight, palette }
987→ // palette: { bg, titleColor, subtitleColor, metaColor, accent, footerColor }
988→ const P = config.palette;
989→ const padL = 1200, padR = 800;
990→
991→ // ⚠️ MANDATORY: Use calcTitleLayout() for dynamic font size + line breaking
992→ const availableWidth = 11906 - padL - padR - 300; // -300 for border space
993→ const { titlePt, titleLines } = calcTitleLayout(config.title, availableWidth, 40, 24);
994→ const titleSize = titlePt * 2;
995→
996→ // ⚠️ MANDATORY: Use calcCoverSpacing() for dynamic spacing
997→ const spacing = calcCoverSpacing({
998→ titleLineCount: titleLines.length, titlePt,
999→ hasSubtitle: !!config.subtitle, hasEnglishLabel: !!config.englishLabel,
1000→ metaLineCount: (config.metaLines || []).length,
1001→ fixedHeight: 400, // footer line only (no nested tables)
1002→ });
1003→
1004→ const accentLeft = { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 8, color: P.accent, space: 12 };
1005→ const children = [];
1006→
1007→ // 1. Top whitespace (dynamic)
1008→ children.push(new Paragraph({ spacing: { before: spacing.topSpacing } }));
1009→
1010→ // 2. English label with accent bottom border
1011→ if (config.englishLabel) {
1012→ children.push(new Paragraph({
1013→ indent: { left: padL, right: padR }, spacing: { after: 500 },
1014→ border: { bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 6, color: P.accent, space: 8 } },
1015→ children: [new TextRun({ text: config.englishLabel.split("").join(" "),
1016→ size: 18, color: P.accent, font: { ascii: "Calibri", eastAsia: "SimHei" }, characterSpacing: 40 })],
1017→ }));
1018→ }
1019→
1020→ // 3. Main title (dynamic font size + smart line breaks)
1021→ for (let i = 0; i < titleLines.length; i++) {
1022→ children.push(new Paragraph({
1023→ indent: { left: padL },
1024→ spacing: { after: i < titleLines.length - 1 ? 100 : 300, line: Math.ceil(titlePt * 23), lineRule: "atLeast" },
1025→ children: [new TextRun({ text: titleLines[i], size: titleSize, bold: true,
1026→ color: P.titleColor, font: { eastAsia: "SimHei", ascii: "Arial" } })],
1027→ }));
1028→ }
1029→
1030→ // 4. Subtitle
1031→ if (config.subtitle) {
1032→ children.push(new Paragraph({
1033→ indent: { left: padL }, spacing: { after: 800 },
1034→ children: [new TextRun({ text: config.subtitle, size: 24, color: P.subtitleColor,
1035→ font: { eastAsia: "Microsoft YaHei", ascii: "Arial" } })],
1036→ }));
1037→ }
1038→
1039→ // 5. Meta info lines with left accent border
1040→ for (const line of (config.metaLines || [])) {
1041→ children.push(new Paragraph({
1042→ indent: { left: padL + 200 }, spacing: { after: 80 },
1043→ border: { left: accentLeft },
1044→ children: [new TextRun({ text: line, size: 24, color: P.metaColor,
1045→ font: { eastAsia: "Microsoft YaHei", ascii: "Arial" } })],
1046→ }));
1047→ }
1048→
1049→ // 6. Bottom whitespace (dynamic)
1050→ children.push(new Paragraph({ spacing: { before: spacing.bottomSpacing } }));
1051→
1052→ // 7. Footer with top accent separator
1053→ children.push(new Paragraph({
1054→ indent: { left: padL, right: padR },
1055→ border: { top: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 2, color: P.accent, space: 8 } },
1056→ spacing: { before: 200 },
1057→ children: [
1058→ new TextRun({ text: config.footerLeft || "", size: 16, color: P.footerColor, font: { ascii: "Arial" } }),
1059→ new TextRun({ text: " " }),
1060→ new TextRun({ text: config.footerRight || "", size: 16, color: P.footerColor, font: { ascii: "Arial" } }),
1061→ ],
1062→ }));
1063→
1064→ // Single 16838 wrapper — the ONLY table
1065→ return [new Table({
1066→ width: { size: 100, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
1067→ layout: TableLayoutType.FIXED,
1068→ borders: allNoBorders,
1069→ rows: [new TableRow({
1070→ height: { value: 16838, rule: "exact" },
1071→ children: [new TableCell({
1072→ shading: { type: ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: P.bg }, borders: noBorders,
1073→ children,
1074→ })],
1075→ })],
1076→ })];
1077→ // Total height: 16838 (single wrapper, zero nested tables) ✅
1078→}
1079→```

1193→### Recipe R3: Centered Card Frame (Paragraph Borders)
1194→
1195→**Visual:** Full-page dark background + centered "card" effect via paragraph indent + 4-side paragraph borders
1196→**Use case:** Research report, product overview, event summary, creative/design documents
1197→**Nested tables: ZERO** — card borders are paragraph borders with large left/right indents
1198→
1199→Visual hierarchy (top to bottom):
1200→1. Pre-card whitespace (~2800tw)
1201→2. Card top edge (paragraph with `border.top` + `border.left` + `border.right`, indent 2200tw)

1203→4. Main title (centered, inside card side borders, dynamic font size)

1320→### Recipe R4: Top Color Block
1321→
1322→**Visual:** Top 45% dark area (with title) + bottom 55% white area (with meta info) + accent divider
1323→**Use case:** business proposal, plan document, lesson plan, PRD
1324→**Architecture:** Uses R1's proven single 16838 wrapper. Upper dark block is a nested table inside the wrapper. Content positioning uses `spacing.before` (reliable) instead of `margins.top` (unreliable across engines).
1325→
1326→```js
1327→// ⚠️ MANDATORY: Cover section must use margin: 0. See "Cover Section Non-Negotiables" above.
1328→function buildCoverR4(config) {
1329→ const P = config.palette;
1330→ const padL = 1200, padR = 800;
1331→ const availableWidth = 11906 - padL - padR;
1332→
1333→ // ⚠️ MANDATORY: Use calcTitleLayout() for dynamic font size + line breaking
1334→ const { titlePt, titleLines } = calcTitleLayout(config.title, availableWidth, 40, 26);
1335→ const titleSize = titlePt * 2;
1336→
1337→ // Height budget for upper dark block — DYNAMIC based on title content
1338→ const titleBlockHeight = titleLines.length * (titlePt * 23 + 200);
1339→ const englishLabelH = config.englishLabel ? (9 * 23 + 500) : 0;
1340→ const subtitleH = config.subtitle ? (12 * 23 + 200) : 0;
1341→ const upperContentH = englishLabelH + titleBlockHeight + subtitleH;
1342→ const UPPER_MIN = 7500; // minimum height to preserve visual proportion
1343→ const UPPER_H = Math.max(UPPER_MIN, upperContentH + 1500 + 800); // +1500 top pad, +800 bottom pad
1344→ const DIVIDER_H = 60;
1345→
1346→ // ★ Dynamic top spacing: calculated from content height, NOT fixed margins.top
1347→ const contentEstimate =
1348→ (config.englishLabel ? (9 * 23 + 500) : 0) +
1349→ titleLines.length * (titlePt * 23 + 200) +
1350→ (config.subtitle ? (12 * 23 + 200) : 0);
1351→ const spacerIntrinsic = 280; // empty spacing paragraph intrinsic height
1352→ const topSpacing = Math.max(UPPER_H - contentEstimate - spacerIntrinsic - 800, 400);

1355→ const upperBlock = new Table({

1383→ }) : null,
1384→ ].filter(Boolean),

1444→
1445→### Recipe R5: Clean White (Academic)
1446→
1447→**Visual:** Pure white background + school name + centered title + 2-column meta info table with underlines + footer
1448→**Use case:** academic thesis, standards documents
1449→**Architecture:** 16838 outer wrapper (white fill, invisible) + cell margins for page margin simulation. No top/bottom decorative lines.
1450→
1451→**Meta info table rules (cross-engine safe):**
1452→- 2-column table: label + value, **percentage widths only** (`WidthType.PERCENTAGE`)
1453→- **Table width is adaptive:** 55–75% of page, calculated by `calcR5MetaLayout()`. Table centered via `alignment: CENTER`.
1454→- **Label column:** adaptive 25–45% of table, **LEFT aligned**, plain text with "：" appended. NO full-width space padding, NO right-alignment.
1455→- **Label column borders:** none (no bottom border on label cells).
1456→- **Value column:** remaining %, **LEFT aligned**, `bottom: single sz=4` border = fixed-length underline (consistent length for all rows regardless of text).
1457→- No left/right/top borders on either column.
1458→- ⚠️ Do NOT use DXA widths, full-width space padding (`\u3000`), spacer columns, or tab stops — WPS renders them inconsistently.
1459→- ⚠️ Do NOT use `margins.top` on the wrapper cell — use `spacing.before` on first paragraph instead.
1460→
1461→**Known limitation:** When meta lines ≥ 6 AND title has 3 lines, MS Office may render content slightly taller than WPS, potentially clipping the footer line. Mitigate by reducing `midSpacing` or using a smaller title font.
1462→
1463→```js
1464→// ── Width-aware title layout (handles mixed Chinese + English) ──
1465→function estimateTextWidth(text, pt) {
1466→ let width = 0;
1467→ for (const ch of text) {
1468→ const code = ch.codePointAt(0);
1469→ const isCJK = (code >= 0x4E00 && code <= 0x9FFF) || (code >= 0x3400 && code <= 0x4DBF) ||
1470→ (code >= 0x3000 && code <= 0x303F) || (code >= 0xFF00 && code <= 0xFFEF) ||
1471→ (code >= 0x2E80 && code <= 0x2EFF);
1472→ width += isCJK ? pt * 20 : pt * 11; // CJK: full-width, Latin: ~55% width
1473→ }
1474→ return width;
1475→}
1476→// Use estimateTextWidth() in calcTitleLayout() instead of simple char count
1477→// to prevent mid-word breaks in mixed Chinese+English titles like "基于Transformer架构的..."
1478→
1479→// ── Meta info table ──
1480→
1481→// Calculate adaptive table and label column percentage based on longest label.
1482→// Returns { tablePct, labelPct } — both as percentages.
1483→// Uses ONLY WidthType.PERCENTAGE for cross-engine compatibility (MS Office + WPS).
1484→function calcR5MetaLayout(metaEntries, fontPt = 12) {
1485→ const maxLabelLen = Math.max(...metaEntries.map(e => [...e.label].length));
1486→ // Label needs: maxLabelLen chars + "：" + 1 char padding
1487→ const labelNeedTw = (maxLabelLen + 2) * fontPt * 20;
1488→ // Value column: fixed ~5000tw for consistent underline length
1489→ const valueNeedTw = 5000;
1490→ const totalNeedTw = labelNeedTw + valueNeedTw;
1491→ // Table width as % of page (11906tw), clamped to 55–75%
1492→ const tablePct = Math.min(75, Math.max(55, Math.ceil(totalNeedTw / 11906 * 100)));
1493→ // Label % within the table, clamped to 25–45%
1494→ const rawLabelPct = Math.ceil(labelNeedTw / (tablePct / 100 * 11906) * 100);
1495→ return { tablePct, labelPct: Math.max(25, Math.min(45, rawLabelPct)) };
1496→}
1497→
1498→// Build R5 academic cover meta info table.
1499→// ⚠️ CRITICAL cross-engine rules:
1500→// - Table width: WidthType.PERCENTAGE (NOT DXA — WPS breaks with DXA)
1501→// - Column widths: WidthType.PERCENTAGE
1502→// - Label column: LEFT aligned, plain text (NO full-width space padding)
1503→// - Value column: LEFT aligned, bottom border = fixed-length underline
1504→// - Table alignment: CENTER (visually centered on page)
1505→function buildR5MetaTable(metaEntries) {
1506→ // metaEntries: [{ label: "学院", value: "计算机科学与技术学院" }, ...]
1507→ const { tablePct, labelPct } = calcR5MetaLayout(metaEntries);
1508→ const valuePct = 100 - labelPct;
1509→ const bottomBorder = { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 4, color: "000000" };
1510→
1511→ const rows = metaEntries.map(entry => new TableRow({
1512→ children: [
1513→ // Label cell: left-aligned, no bottom border
1514→ new TableCell({
1515→ width: { size: labelPct, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
1516→ borders: noBorders,
1517→ margins: { top: 60, bottom: 60, left: 0, right: 0 },
1518→ children: [new Paragraph({
1519→ alignment: AlignmentType.LEFT,
1520→ spacing: { before: 60, after: 60, line: 400 },
1521→ children: [new TextRun({
1522→ text: entry.label + "：",
1523→ size: 24, font: { eastAsia: "SimSun", ascii: "Times New Roman" },
1524→ })],
1525→ })],
1526→ }),
1527→ // Value cell: left-aligned, bottom border = fixed-length underline
1528→ new TableCell({
1529→ width: { size: valuePct, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
1530→ borders: { top: NB, left: NB, right: NB, bottom: bottomBorder },
1531→ margins: { top: 60, bottom: 60, left: 80, right: 0 },
1532→ children: [new Paragraph({
1533→ alignment: AlignmentType.LEFT,
1534→ spacing: { before: 60, after: 60, line: 400 },
1535→ children: [new TextRun({
1536→ text: entry.value,
1537→ size: 24, font: { eastAsia: "SimSun", ascii: "Times New Roman" },
1538→ })],
1539→ })],
1540→ }),
1541→ ],
1542→ }));
1543→
1544→ return new Table({
1545→ width: { size: tablePct, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
1546→ alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
1547→ layout: TableLayoutType.FIXED,
1548→ borders: allNoBorders,
1549→ rows,
1550→ });
1551→}
1552→
1553→// ⚠️ MANDATORY: Cover section must use margin: 0. See "Cover Section Non-Negotiables" above.
1554→function buildCoverR5(config) {
1555→ const PAGE_H = 16838, SAFETY = 1200;
1556→ const safeH = PAGE_H - SAFETY; // 15638
1557→ const simMarginLR = 1701, simMarginT = 1200;
1558→ const contentW = 11906 - simMarginLR * 2;
1559→
1560→ // ★ Width-aware title layout for mixed Chinese+English
1561→ const { titlePt, titleLines } = calcTitleLayoutMixed(config.title, contentW, 36, 24);
1562→ const titleSize = titlePt * 2;
1563→
1564→ // Parse meta entries
1565→ const metaEntries = (config.metaLines || []).map(line => {
1566→ const sep = line.indexOf("：") !== -1 ? "：" : ":";
1567→ const idx = line.indexOf(sep);
1568→ if (idx === -1) return { label: line, value: "" };
1569→ return { label: line.slice(0, idx).trim(), value: line.slice(idx + sep.length).trim() };
1570→ });
1571→
1572→ // Height budget (no margins.top — use spacing.before instead)
1573→ const schoolNameH = config.schoolName ? (22 * 23 + 400) : 0;
1574→ const titleTotalH = titleLines.length * (titlePt * 23 + 200);
1575→ const subtitleH = config.subtitle ? (15 * 23 + 600) : 0;
1576→ const metaRowH = 520; // 60+60 padding + ~400 line height
1577→ const metaTableH = metaEntries.length * metaRowH;
1578→ const footerH = config.footerRight ? (12 * 23 + 200) : 0;
1579→ const spacerParas = 3 * 350;
1580→ const fixedH = schoolNameH + titleTotalH + subtitleH + metaTableH + footerH + spacerParas;
1581→ const remaining = Math.max(safeH - fixedH, 600);
1582→
1583→ // ★ topSpacing includes simulated top margin (simMarginT)
1584→ const topSpacing = Math.min(Math.floor(remaining * 0.28) + simMarginT, 4200);
1585→ const midSpacing = Math.min(Math.floor((remaining - simMarginT) * 0.18), 2000);
1586→ const bottomSpacing = Math.min(remaining - topSpacing + simMarginT - midSpacing, 5500);
1587→
1588→ const children = [];
1589→ children.push(new Paragraph({ spacing: { before: topSpacing } }));
1590→
1591→ // School name (optional)
1592→ if (config.schoolName) {
1593→ children.push(new Paragraph({
1594→ alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER, spacing: { after: 400 },
1595→ children: [new TextRun({ text: config.schoolName, size: 44, characterSpacing: 40,
1596→ font: { eastAsia: "SimSun", ascii: "Times New Roman" } })],
1597→ }));
1598→ }
1599→
1600→ // Title
1601→ for (let i = 0; i < titleLines.length; i++) {
1602→ children.push(new Paragraph({
1603→ alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER, spacing: { after: i < titleLines.length - 1 ? 120 : 300 },
1604→ children: [new TextRun({ text: titleLines[i], size: titleSize, bold: true,
1605→ font: { eastAsia: "SimHei", ascii: "Times New Roman" } })],
1606→ }));
1607→ }
1608→
1609→ // Subtitle
1610→ if (config.subtitle) {
1611→ children.push(new Paragraph({
1612→ alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER, spacing: { after: 200 },
1613→ children: [new TextRun({ text: config.subtitle, size: 30,
1614→ font: { eastAsia: "SimSun", ascii: "Times New Roman" } })],
1615→ }));
1616→ }
1617→
1618→ children.push(new Paragraph({ spacing: { before: midSpacing } }));
1619→
1620→ // Meta info table
1621→ if (metaEntries.length > 0) children.push(buildR5MetaTable(metaEntries));
1622→
1623→ children.push(new Paragraph({ spacing: { before: bottomSpacing } }));
1624→
1625→ // Footer
1626→ if (config.footerRight) {
1627→ children.push(new Paragraph({
1628→ alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
1629→ children: [new TextRun({ text: config.footerRight, size: 24, color: "404040",
1630→ font: { eastAsia: "SimSun", ascii: "Times New Roman" } })],
1631→ }));
1632→ }
1633→
1634→ // ★ 16838 outer wrapper — only left/right margins, NO margins.top
1635→ return [new Table({
1636→ width: { size: 100, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
1637→ layout: TableLayoutType.FIXED,
1638→ borders: allNoBorders,
1639→ rows: [new TableRow({
1640→ height: { value: PAGE_H, rule: "exact" },
1641→ children: [new TableCell({
1642→ shading: { type: ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: "FFFFFF" },
1643→ borders: noBorders, verticalAlign: "top",
1644→ margins: { left: simMarginLR, right: simMarginLR },
1645→ children,
1646→ })],
1647→ })],
1648→ })];
1649→ // Height budget example (short title, 4 meta lines):
1650→ // topSpacing(3818) + schoolName(906) + title(1028) + subtitle(945) + midSpacing(1467)
1651→ // + metaTable(4×520=2080) + bottomSpacing(5268) + footer(476) = ~15988 < 15838 ✅
1652→}

1657→### blendColors Utility Function
1658→
1659→```js
1660→function blendColors(hex1, hex2, ratio) {
1661→ const p = (s, i) => parseInt(s.replace("#","").slice(i, i+2), 16);
1662→ const mix = (c1, c2) => Math.round(c1 + (c2 - c1) * ratio);
1663→ const r = mix(p(hex1,0), p(hex2,0)), g = mix(p(hex1,2), p(hex2,2)), b = mix(p(hex1,4), p(hex2,4));
1664→ return [r, g, b].map(v => v.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
1665→}
1666→```

1698→## Chart Quality Rules
1699→
1700→### Chart Color Palette
1701→
1702→Default: **low-saturation (Morandi style)** palette to avoid flashy high-saturation. High-saturation palette only for explicitly energetic scenarios (events/education/creative).
1703→
1704→```js
1705→const chartColors = {
1706→ // Default: low saturation, professional (S: 25-40%, L: 55-68%)
1707→ default: ["6B9DAD", "C49B72", "7BA68A", "B87472", "9687A8", "C8B87C", "7AADA0", "7A9BB8"],
1708→ // Vivid: only for energetic/creative scenes
1709→ vivid: ["2F97B8", "E67E22", "27AE60", "E74C3C", "9B59B6", "F1C40F", "1ABC9C", "3498DB"],
1710→};
1711→
1712→// Scene selection:
1713→// - report/whitepaper/consulting/academic/contract → default
1714→// - activity/education/creative copy → vivid (optional)
1715→```
1716→
1717→**Color usage rules:**
1718→- Max **5 colors** per chart; excess categories use depth variants of same hue
1719→- Emphasis data uses document accent color; non-emphasis uses grey `#B0B0B0`
1720→- Adjacent segments in pie/bar charts must have hue gap ≥ 60°
1721→
1722→1. **Anti-overlap**: If >6 x-axis labels, rotate 45° (`plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')`)
1723→2. **Anti-stretch**: Always set figure size explicitly (`fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))`)
1724→3. **Aspect ratio (CRITICAL)**: When embedding in docx, MUST read actual image dimensions and calculate height proportionally. NEVER hardcode both width and height — pie charts become ellipses, radar charts become diamonds.
1725→ ```js
1726→ const sizeOf = require("image-size");
1727→ const dims = sizeOf(chartBuffer);
1728→ const displayWidth = 500;
1729→ const displayHeight = Math.round(displayWidth * (dims.height / dims.width));
1730→ // transformation: { width: displayWidth, height: displayHeight }
1731→ ```
1732→4. **DPI**: Save at 200+ DPI (`plt.savefig("chart.png", dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight")`)
1733→5. **Colors**: Use palette accent color for primary data series
1734→6. **Legend**: Place outside plot area if >4 series
1735→7. **Square charts**: Pie and radar charts MUST use `figsize=(8, 8)` (equal width/height) to preserve circular/radial shape
1736→7. **Grid**: Light gray grid (`ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)`)

1740→## Typography Rules
1741→
1742→### CJK Body Text
1743→- **Alignment**: Justified (`AlignmentType.JUSTIFIED`)
1744→- **First-line indent**: 2 characters — Profile A (SimSun): `firstLine: 480`; Profile B (YaHei): `firstLine: 420`. See `common-rules.md` for profile definitions.
1745→- **Line spacing**: 1.3x = `spacing: { line: 312 }`
1746→- **No heading indent**: Headings must NOT have first-line indent
1747→
1748→### English Body Text
1749→- **Alignment**: Left (`AlignmentType.LEFT`)
1750→- **No indent**
1751→- **Line spacing**: Same 1.3x
1752→
1753→### Table Numbers
1754→- Right-aligned in cells
1755→- Use monospace or tabular figures if available
1756→
1757→### Headings
1758→- No first-line indent
1759→- `spacing: { before: 240, after: 120 }` (H1: before 360)
1760→- Bold, palette.primary color
1761→
1762→### 1.3x Line Spacing — MANDATORY
1763→Every document, every paragraph. `spacing: { line: 312 }`. No exceptions unless scene explicitly overrides (e.g., resume uses 1.15x).

1774→ margin: { top: 1440, bottom: 1440, left: 1701, right: 1417 },
1775→ // Top/bottom 2.54cm = 1440, left 3.0cm = 1701, right 2.5cm = 1417 twips

1783→
1784→### Scene Font Override Rules
1785→
1786→Default font config (docx-js Font Configuration in design-system.md) uses YaHei+Calibri for most business scenarios. The following scenes have dedicated font requirements — **scene rules override defaults**:
1787→
1788→| Scene | Body CN | Body EN | Headings | Body Color |
1789→|------|----------|----------|------|----------|
1790→| Default (general) | Microsoft YaHei | Calibri | SimHei + Calibri | palette.body |
1791→| **Report** | **SimSun** | **Times New Roman** | **SimHei + TNR** | **"000000" (pure black)** |
1792→| **Academic** | **SimSun** | **Times New Roman** | **SimHei + TNR** | **"000000" (pure black)** |
1793→| **Contract** | **SimSun** | **Times New Roman** | **SimHei + TNR** | **"000000" (pure black)** |
1794→| Official doc | FangSong | — | STXiaoBiaoSong | "000000" |
1795→| Resume | Microsoft YaHei | Calibri | SimHei + Calibri | palette.body |
1796→
1797→When report or academic scene is loaded, `styles.default.document.run` font and color must be overridden per scene. Heading sizes may also differ (e.g., report scene H1 centered, H2 uses Xiao San size:30 instead of default Si Hao size:28). Scene file takes precedence.

1→ 1→# Design System — DOCX Skill
2→ 2→
3→ 3→## Color Philosophy
4→ 4→
5→ 5→GLM uses a **mood-driven dynamic color system** instead of fixed named palettes. Colors are constructed from three dimensions:
6→ 6→
7→ 7→### Three Dimensions of Document Color
8→ 8→
9→ 9→| Dimension | Description | Range |
10→ 10→|-----------|-------------|-------|
11→ 11→| **Temperature** | Warm ↔ Cool | Warm (consulting, education) ↔ Cool (tech, medical) |
12→ 12→| **Weight** | Light ↔ Heavy | Light (resume, proposal) ↔ Heavy (legal, academic) |
13→ 13→| **Energy** | Calm ↔ Active | Calm (official, contract) ↔ Active (report, presentation) |
14→ 14→
15→ 15→### Color Token System
16→ 16→
17→ 17→Every document uses 5 color tokens. These are **computed** based on the document's mood, not selected from a fixed list.
18→ 18→
19→ 19→| Token | Role | Guidance |
20→ 20→|-------|------|----------|
21→ 21→| `primary` | Headings, cover title | Dark, authoritative. Derived from Temperature + Weight. |
22→ 22→| `body` | Body text | Near-black with subtle warmth/coolness. Always high contrast. |
23→ 23→| `secondary` | Captions, footnotes | Mid-tone gray. Legible but visually recessive. |
24→ 24→| `accent` | Table headers, lines, links | The "personality" color. Reflects document Energy. |
25→ 25→| `surface` | Table alternating rows, card backgrounds | Very light tint of accent or neutral. |

156→ 156→
157→ 157→### Visual Profile Color Guidance
158→ 158→
159→ 159→For **Profile B (Visual)** scenes — resume, copywriting, and other non-formal documents — prefer **warm neutral** tones aligned with the "Invisible Precision" design philosophy:
160→ 160→
161→ 161→- **Body text**: Use warm dark neutrals (`#37352F`, `#303030`, `#3A3430`) instead of cool blue-grays. This reduces eye strain.
162→ 162→- **Surface/background**: Use warm near-white (`#F7F7F7`, `#FAFAF8`, `#FBF9F7`) instead of cool tints.
163→ 163→- **Accent colors**: Use sparingly and only for functional differentiation (section headers, key metrics, links). 95% of the document should remain monochromatic (black, white, gray).
164→ 164→- **Tables**: Prefer the **Zebra Stripe** style (see Table Styles §2) — hierarchy through background contrast with minimal borders. Fallback: Horizontal-Only.
165→ 165→
166→ 166→This does NOT apply to Profile A (Formal) scenes (report, academic, contract, official-doc, exam), which must retain pure black `"000000"` body text per regulatory standards.
167→ 167→
168→ 168→### Custom Color Generation
169→ 169→
170→ 170→When the pre-defined recipes don't fit, construct colors using these rules:
171→ 171→
172→ 172→1. **primary**: Start from `hsl(hue, 25-40%, 10-18%)` — dark, desaturated
173→ 173→2. **body**: primary lightened 5-8% — readable dark
174→ 174→3. **secondary**: primary lightened 30-40% — clearly subordinate
175→ 175→4. **accent**: Choose a hue reflecting the domain, `hsl(domainHue, 30-50%, 45-55%)`
176→ 176→5. **surface**: accent desaturated to 5-10%, lightened to 96-98%
177→ 177→
178→ 178→**Contrast check**: body text on white must achieve WCAG AA (≥4.5:1). All recipes above pass this.

254→ 254→
255→ 255→## Table Styles
256→ 256→
257→ 257→**Profile routing:** Profile A (Formal: report, academic, contract, exam) → Three-Line Table or Horizontal-Only Table. Profile B (Visual: resume, copywriting) → Zebra Stripe (preferred) or Horizontal-Only Table.
258→ 258→
259→ 259→### 1. Three-Line Table (三线表) — Academic
260→ 260→
261→ 261→Only three horizontal lines: top of table, bottom of header, bottom of table.
262→ 262→
263→ 263→```js
264→ 264→const threeLineTable = new Table({
265→ 265→ width: { size: 100, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
266→ 266→ borders: {
267→ 267→ top: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 4, color: "000000" },
268→ 268→ bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 4, color: "000000" },
269→ 269→ left: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
270→ 270→ right: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
271→ 271→ insideHorizontal: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
272→ 272→ insideVertical: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
273→ 273→ },
274→ 274→ rows: [
275→ 275→ new TableRow({
276→ 276→ children: headerCells.map(text => new TableCell({
277→ 277→ children: [new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun({ text, bold: true, size: 21 })] })],
278→ 278→ borders: {
279→ 279→ bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 2, color: "000000" },
280→ 280→ top: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
281→ 281→ left: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
282→ 282→ right: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
283→ 283→ },
284→ 284→ margins: { top: 60, bottom: 60, left: 120, right: 120 },
285→ 285→ })),
286→ 286→ }),
287→ 287→ // ... data rows with all borders NONE
288→ 288→ ],
289→ 289→});
290→ 290→```
291→ 291→
292→ 292→### 2. Zebra Stripe — Data Reports
293→ 293→
294→ 294→```js
295→ 295→function zebraRow(cells, index, palette) {
296→ 296→ return new TableRow({
297→ 297→ children: cells.map(text => new TableCell({
298→ 298→ children: [new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun({ text, size: 21 })] })],
299→ 299→ shading: index % 2 === 0
300→ 300→ ? { type: ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: palette.surface }
301→ 301→ : { type: ShadingType.CLEAR, fill: "FFFFFF" },
302→ 302→ margins: { top: 60, bottom: 60, left: 120, right: 120 },
303→ 303→ })),
304→ 304→ });
305→ 305→}
306→ 306→```
307→ 307→
308→ 308→### 3. Horizontal-Only — Business (Default)
309→ 309→
310→ 310→```js
311→ 311→const horizontalTable = new Table({
312→ 312→ width: { size: 100, type: WidthType.PERCENTAGE },
313→ 313→ borders: {
314→ 314→ top: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 2, color: palette.accent.replace("#","") },
315→ 315→ bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 2, color: palette.accent.replace("#","") },
316→ 316→ left: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
317→ 317→ right: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
318→ 318→ insideHorizontal: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 1, color: "D0D0D0" },
319→ 319→ insideVertical: { style: BorderStyle.NONE },
320→ 320→ },
321→ 321→ rows: [/* header row with accent shading, then data rows */],
322→ 322→});
323→ 323→```
324→ 324→
325→ 325→**⚠️ CRITICAL**: Always set `margins` at the Table or TableCell level. Without margins, text touches cell borders.
326→ 326→
327→ 327→### Table Color Token Derivation
328→ 328→
329→ 329→Each palette in `coverPalettes` provides a `table` object with pre-computed colors for all 3 table styles:
330→ 330→
331→ 331→| Token | Used in | Description |
332→ 332→|-------|---------|-------------|
333→ 333→| `table.headerBg` | Zebra Stripe, Horizontal-Only | Table header background color |
334→ 334→| `table.headerText` | Zebra Stripe, Horizontal-Only | Table header text color (must pass WCAG AA contrast) |
335→ 335→| `table.accentLine` | Three-Line | Top/bottom/header-bottom line color |
336→ 336→| `table.innerLine` | Horizontal-Only | Inner horizontal separator line color |
337→ 337→| `table.surface` | Zebra Stripe | Alternating row background (light tint) |
338→ 338→
339→ 339→**Usage:**
340→ 340→```js
341→ 341→const palette = coverPalettes["DS-1"];
342→ 342→const t = palette.table;
343→ 343→// Three-Line: use t.accentLine for border colors
344→ 344→// Zebra: use t.headerBg, t.headerText, t.surface
345→ 345→// Horizontal: use t.headerBg, t.headerText, t.innerLine
346→ 346→```
347→ 347→
348→ 348→**⚠️ High-saturation accent override**: For DM-1, FG-1, and SN-2, the table colors are intentionally darkened/desaturated relative to the cover accent. Bright accent colors that look good on dark cover backgrounds are too eye-straining on white body pages. Always use `palette.table.*` for tables, never the raw `palette.accent`.
349→ 349→

352→ 352→
353→ 353→## Cover Page Design System
354→ 354→
355→ 355→### Design Philosophy
356→ 356→
357→ 357→Covers use **7 validated layout recipes** + **parameterized variants** instead of free combination. Each recipe's background, layout, and decoration are visually verified. Differentiation comes from **palette × font size × content variation**.
358→ 358→
359→ 359→**Architecture principle:** All recipes use a **single 16838 outer wrapper table** (one row, exact height). Recipes R1/R2/R3 use **ZERO nested tables** — all decoration is achieved via **paragraph borders** (left/right/top/bottom). This ensures maximum cross-engine stability (MS Office + WPS).
360→ 360→
361→ 361→### Cover Color Palettes (Dark Mode + Light Mode)
362→ 362→
363→ 363→Each palette defines 3 core colors (Background, Primary, Accent) + derived cover/table tokens.
364→ 364→
365→ 365→⚠️ **Disambiguation: `cover.titleColor` is a COLOR value, not title text.** All keys under `cover: { ... }` are **color hex codes** for styling cover text elements. They are NOT text content. The actual title text comes from `config.title`. Never use `P.titleColor` as the `text` parameter of a `TextRun` — it must only be used as the `color` parameter.
366→ 366→
367→ 367→```js
368→ 368→// ✅ Correct — config.title is the text, P.titleColor is the color
369→ 369→new TextRun({ text: config.title, color: P.titleColor })
370→ 370→
371→ 371→// ❌ WRONG — using color value as text content
372→ 372→new TextRun({ text: P.titleColor, color: P.titleColor }) // displays "FFFFFF" as visible text!
373→ 373→```

456→ 456→ },

467→ 467→### ⚠️ Dark Cover → Light Table Rule
468→ 468→
469→ 469→Covers with dark backgrounds (DS-1, IG-1, DM-1, FG-1, GO-1) use bright accent on dark bg.
470→ 470→Body page tables are always on WHITE background — table colors use **darkened/desaturated** variants of the accent.
471→ 471→High-saturation accent colors (DM-1 #37DCF2, FG-1 #3DDBB5, SN-2 #B13DC6) are explicitly overridden in `table.*` fields above.

474→ 474→
475→ 475→SN-2 (Soft Purple) is restricted to creative/branding/event documents ONLY.
476→ 476→It MUST NOT be used for: business reports, consulting, finance, legal, government, medical, or technical documents.

501→ 501→### ⚠️ Recipe Routing Rules (Replaces Free Selection)
502→ 502→
503→ 503→```js
504→ 504→function selectCoverRecipe(docType, industry, titleLength) {
505→ 505→ // No cover for these types
506→ 506→ if (["contract", "official", "exam", "resume"].includes(docType)) return null;
507→ 507→
508→ 508→ // Academic
509→ 509→ if (docType === "academic") return { recipe: "R5", palette: "ACADEMIC" };
510→ 510→
511→ 511→ // Thesis proposal report (开题报告)
512→ 512→ if (docType === "proposal_report") return { recipe: "R5", palette: "ACADEMIC" };
513→ 513→
514→ 514→ // Lesson plans — R6 editorial for arts/general, R4 for STEM
515→ 515→ if (docType === "lesson_plan" || docType === "lessonplan") {
516→ 516→ const stemKeywords = ["math", "physics", "chemistry", "biology", "science", "tech", "computer", "engineering"];
517→ 517→ if (stemKeywords.some(k => (industry || "").toLowerCase().includes(k))) {
518→ 518→ return { recipe: "R4", palette: "DM-1" };
519→ 519→ }
520→ 520→ // Arts, general, and all other lesson plans → R6 editorial
521→ 521→ return { recipe: "R6", palette: "ED-1" };
522→ 522→ }
523→ 523→
524→ 524→ // Creative/branding/design (formal) → R3 centered card frame
525→ 525→ if (["creative", "branding", "design"].includes(docType)) {
526→ 526→ return { recipe: "R3", palette: "SN-2" };
527→ 527→ }
528→ 528→
529→ 529→ // Cultural/newsletter/internal (casual) → R6 editorial
530→ 530→ if (["cultural", "newsletter", "internal"].includes(docType)) {
531→ 531→ return { recipe: "R6", palette: "ED-1" };
532→ 532→ }
533→ 533→
534→ 534→ // Activity/event planning → R6 editorial
535→ 535→ if (docType === "activity") return { recipe: "R6", palette: "ED-1" };
536→ 536→
537→ 537→ // Trend/research reports in cultural/creative/brand fields → R7 Swiss Tech
538→ 538→ if (docType === "trend_report" || docType === "research_report") {
539→ 539→ if (["cultural", "creative", "brand", "design"].includes(industry)) {
540→ 540→ return { recipe: "R7", palette: "ST-1" };
541→ 541→ }
542→ 542→ }
543→ 543→
544→ 544→ // Formal/business subtypes
545→ 545→ if (docType === "whitepaper") return { recipe: "R2", palette: industry === "finance" ? "IG-1" : "CM-2" };
546→ 546→ if (docType === "consulting") return { recipe: "R2", palette: "MIN-1" };
547→ 547→ if (docType === "proposal" || docType === "plan") return { recipe: "R4", palette: "GO-1" };
548→ 548→
549→ 549→ // Reports — palette by industry, use R1
550→ 550→ if (docType === "report") {
551→ 551→ const paletteMap = {
552→ 552→ finance: "IG-1", consulting: "MIN-1",
553→ 553→ tech: "DM-1", ai: "DM-1",
554→ 554→ education: "WM-1", green: "FG-1",
555→ 555→ medical: "MC-1", government: "GV-1",
556→ 556→ };
557→ 557→ return { recipe: "R1", palette: paletteMap[industry] || "DS-1" };
558→ 558→ }
559→ 559→
560→ 560→ // Default
561→ 561→ return { recipe: "R1", palette: "DS-1" };
562→ 562→}
563→ 563→
564→ 564→// ── Long-title override (applied AFTER initial recipe selection) ──
565→ 565→// Call this after selectCoverRecipe() when the actual title text is known.
566→ 566→function applyLongTitleOverride(result, titleLength) {
567→ 567→ if (!result || !result.recipe) return result;
568→ 568→ // R5 (academic) is never overridden — it has its own calcTitleLayoutMixed()
569→ 569→ if (result.recipe === "R5") return result;
570→ 570→ // R6 (editorial) is designed for short titles only (≤20 chars, single line)
571→ 571→ // Long titles → fall back to R1 (handles long titles best)
572→ 572→ if (titleLength > 20 && result.recipe === "R6") {
573→ 573→ return { recipe: "R1", palette: "WM-1" }; // ED-1 has no dark bg, use WM-1 (warm teal)
574→ 574→ }
575→ 575→ // R3/R4 struggle with long titles → fall back to R1 (same palette)
576→ 576→ if (titleLength > 20 && ["R3", "R4"].includes(result.recipe)) {
577→ 577→ return { recipe: "R1", palette: result.palette };
578→ 578→ }
579→ 579→ // Very long titles: even R2 centered looks scattered → R1 left-aligned
580→ 580→ if (titleLength > 30 && result.recipe === "R2") {
581→ 581→ return { recipe: "R1", palette: result.palette };
582→ 582→ }
583→ 583→ return result;
584→ 584→}
